questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of the Reserve Bank of India:
I. The MPC consists of six members: three from RBI and three appointed by the Central Government.
II. The Governor of the Reserve Bank of India acts as the ex-officio Chairperson of the MPC.
III. The MPC is mandated to maintain consumer price index (CPI) inflation within 4% with a tolerance band of +/- 2%.
IV. The Governor has a casting vote in the event of an equality of votes.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: Under Section 45ZB of the RBI Act 1934, all four statements regarding the composition, inflation targeting band (4% +/- 2%), and Governor's casting vote are strictly valid.

questions.question:
Match List-I (Economic Planning Models in India) with List-II (Respective Five Year Plans):
List-I:
(a) Harrod-Domar Model
(b) P.C. Mahalanobis Heavy Industrialization Model
(c) Gadgil Formula on Plan Allocation
(d) Rao-Manmohan Singh LPG Model
List-II:
1. Second Five Year Plan (1956-61)
2. First Five Year Plan (1951-56)
3. Eighth Five Year Plan (1992-97)
4. Fourth Five Year Plan (1969-74)
Choose the correct answer:
(a) - (b) - (c) - (d)
questions.explanation: First Plan = Harrod-Domar; Second Plan = Mahalanobis; Fourth Plan = Gadgil Formula; Eighth Plan = Rao-Manmohan LPG reforms.

questions.question:
Assertion [A]: Goods and Services Tax (GST) is a destination-based consumption tax levied at every stage of value addition.
Reason [R]: The input tax credit (ITC) mechanism ensures that the tax is paid only on the value added at each stage, eliminating the cascading effect of taxation.
Select the correct answer:
options: Both [A] and [R] are true, and [R] is the correct explanation of [A]
Both [A] and [R] are true, but [R] is NOT the correct explanation of [A]
questions.explanation: GST is a destination tax where ITC ensures tax is borne solely by final consumers without cascading tax-on-tax.

questions.question:
Consider the following criteria used by the 15th Finance Commission headed by N.K. Singh for determining horizontal devolution of tax shares to States:
I. Income Distance (45%)
II. Population according to 2011 Census (15%)
III. Demographic Performance (12.5%)
IV. Forest and Ecology (10%)
Which of the criteria given above are correctly matched with their assigned weights?
questions.explanation: All criteria and weights are officially correct for the 15th Finance Commission: Income Distance 45%, Population 15%, Demographic Performance 12.5%, Forest & Ecology 10%, Area 15%, Tax Effort 2.5%.
